questions.question: How is King Manasseh first described?
options: He was righteous and tore down all of the idols
He did much evil, rebuilding high places and idols
He was weak and left the throne to other men
He was peaceful and carefully avoided every war
questions.answer: He did much evil, rebuilding high places and idols

questions.question: What happened to Manasseh that led him to repent?
options: A prophet warned him of his coming destruction
Assyria captured him with hooks and bound him in Babylon
His own sons rose up and drove him out from his royal throne
A severe drought ruined the harvest of his land
questions.answer: Assyria captured him with hooks and bound him in Babylon

questions.question: When Manasseh humbled himself, God brought him back to Jerusalem.
Manasseh's son _____ also did evil and was killed by his servants.
In distress Manasseh humbled himself greatly before the God of his _____.
